response.rationale: The order status is "processing" and days_since_delivery is null, meaning the item has not yet been delivered. None of the candidate rules apply on the current facts: the standard-window rules (RET-007/RET-008) require a known days_since_delivery value, which is missing; the electronics rules do not apply (category is apparel); defective is null so RET-020 does not fire; final_sale is False so RET-012 does not apply; and goodwill_grant and fraud_hold are both False. Since no return-eligibility rule condition is satisfied, there is no basis to grant a return at this time (the item is still processing and not yet delivered).
